outcome.analysis: The short oldest page could contain at most four evidence references but still had a budget of five; the equal split used at most fifteen of sixteen global reads. The recorded result verified thirteen and had no unavailable reads.
outcome.analysis_basis: Derived from the authenticated page limits and saved projection result; it does not establish agent time, token, or resource impact.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Equal page budgets can leave observation reads unused while denser pages omit records
pressure_hypothesis.basis: An authentic multi-page query had a fixed five-record allowance per page, 13 verified observations, zero unavailable observations, and a four-reference oldest page while records remained unread on denser pages.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Redistribute the global observation ceiling according to verified unique observation-reference capacity and expose each page's capacity and assigned budget.
